description: Raw historical business observations for student model development. This dataset is intentionally not cleaned, filtered, feature-engineered, labeled, or split for machine learning.
purpose: Raw stable make-to-stock demand/inventory evidence. Students must distinguish normal noise from structural inventory/demand changes.
analysis_expectations: Is demand truly stable over the full history?
When does incoming supply create excess inventory?
How should holding/working-capital pressure affect labels?
Which anomalies should be retained as genuine business events?
student_warning: Do not modify the raw evidence or treat every anomaly as an error. Create derived supervised datasets and document cleaning/label assumptions.
